items: Speak: Retiam Animation for spoken narration. Synchronizes speech synthesis (Kokoro WebGPU or Microsoft Edge Neural), voiceover auto-ducking on Retiam's [[AudioManager]], timeline pacing, closed captions/subtitles, and entity micro-animations.

speak: High-level helper function to speak narration in a Retiam Scene. Synthesizes speech using Kokoro-82M WebGPU or Microsoft Edge Neural TTS, synchronizes subtitles, ducks background music, and pauses scene progression for the duration of the audio.

High-level helper function to speak narration in a Retiam Scene. Synthesizes speech using Kokoro-82M WebGPU or Microsoft Edge Neural TTS, synchronizes subtitles, ducks background music, and pauses scene progression for the duration of the audio.

cells: TTS engine provider ("kokoro" or "msedge"). Defaults to active provider. [Source line 12](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/libs/tts/animations/Speak.ts#L12).
Voice ID for narration (e.g. "af_heart" or "en-US-JennyNeural"). [Source line 14](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/libs/tts/animations/Speak.ts#L14).
Speaking rate multiplier. Defaults to 1.0. [Source line 16](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/libs/tts/animations/Speak.ts#L16).
Pitch shift (for MsEdge TTS, e.g. "+0Hz", "+5st", "+10%"). [Source line 18](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/libs/tts/animations/Speak.ts#L18).
Optional Subtitles component to automatically synchronize closed captions. [Source line 20](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/libs/tts/animations/Speak.ts#L20).
Optional entity to animate with speaking micro-pulses. [Source line 22](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/libs/tts/animations/Speak.ts#L22).
Amplitude of speaking pulse on target entity. Defaults to 0.05. [Source line 24](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/libs/tts/animations/Speak.ts#L24).
Background music volume ducking ratio during speech. Defaults to 0.25 (75% ducking). [Source line 26](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/libs/tts/animations/Speak.ts#L26).
Playback volume multiplier (0.0 to 1.0). Defaults to 1.0. [Source line 28](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/libs/tts/animations/Speak.ts#L28).
